components.name: Primary continuation button
components.description: The sole filled continuation action in the top command bar.
components.css: .ds-primary{height:40px;padding:0 17px;border:1px solid #f04a1d;border-radius:10px;background:#f04a1d;color:#fff;font:650 14px/1 Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out}.ds-primary:hover{border-color:#ff6a42;background:#df3e14}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-primary:active{transform:scale(.98)}

components.name: Dark icon control
components.description: A compact map or command action designed to recede over dark chrome.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" aria-label="打开天气"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 16a4 4 0 1 1 1-7.9A5.5 5.5 0 0 1 17.7 10H18a3 3 0 0 1 0 6H6Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button>

components.name: Focused command search
components.description: An expanding search field that preserves bar density until invoked.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><input placeholder="搜索地点" aria-label="搜索地点"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="5.8" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"/><path d="m15.2 15.2 4.2 4.2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></label>
components.css: .ds-search{position:relative;display:block;width:270px;height:40px;color:#fff}.ds-search input{width:100%;height:40px;padding:0 44px 0 14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:22px;outline:0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff;font:14px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}.ds-search input:focus{background:rgba(18,24,28,.96)}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-search svg{position:absolute;right:12px;top:10px;width:19px;height:19px;pointer-events:none}

components.name: Map terrain switch
components.description: A compact segmented chooser for synchronized map and terrain views.
components.css: .ds-switch{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:20px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.ds-switch button{min-width:58px;height:32px;border:0;border-radius:16px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.68);font:600 13px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-switch button:hover{color:#fff}.ds-switch button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-switch .ds-active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}

components.name: Map tool rail
components.description: High-frequency planning navigation: dark and frosted on desktop, light and labeled on mobile.
components.html: <nav class="ds-rail" aria-label="行程工具"><button class="ds-logo">T3</button><button class="ds-active">规划</button><button>线路库</button><button>天气</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail{display:grid;gap:3px;width:52px;padding:6px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(24,30,34,.78);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(8,12,14,.22);color:#fff;backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(112%)}.ds-rail button{min-height:40px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:10px;background:transparent;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font:600 10px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 140ms ease-out,border-color 140ms ease-out,color 140ms ease-out,transform 100ms ease-out}.ds-rail .ds-logo{background:#f7f7f4;color:#1f2428;font-weight:800}.ds-rail button:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18);background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:#fff}.ds-rail button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}.ds-rail .ds-active{border-color:#f04a1d;background:#f04a1d;color:#fff}.ds-rail button:active{transform:scale(.98)}

components.name: Map context card
components.description: A quiet light-frosted label anchored directly to the map.
components.html: 2D 路线地图2 个途经点 · 点击继续添加
components.css: .ds-map-context{display:grid;gap:3px;width:max-content;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.16);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(247,247,244,.9);box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(18,24,28,.11);color:#1f2428;font-family:Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.ds-map-context b{font-size:12px}.ds-map-context span{font-size:10px;color:#5f696f}

components.name: Journey summary and selected row
components.description: A compact trip summary that expands into grouped itinerary rows, not individual metric cards.
components.html: 行程摘要11.9 km爬升 2,312 m
components.css: .ds-journey{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.16);border-radius:16px;background:rgba(250,250,247,.94);color:#1f2428;font-family:Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(108%)}.ds-journey header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:58px;padding:0 14px}.ds-journey header b{font-size:14px}.ds-journey header span{padding-left:10px;border-left:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.16);color:#5f696f;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:58px;padding:8px 10px;border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.16);background:#fff;color:#1f2428;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-row span b,.ds-row span small{display:block}.ds-row span b{color:#f04a1d;font-size:12px}.ds-row span small,.ds-row em{color:#5f696f;font-size:10px;font-style:normal}.ds-row strong{font-size:11px}.ds-row.ds-selected{background:rgba(240,74,29,.06);box-shadow:inset 1px 0 #f04a1d}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:-2px}

components.css: .ds-weather{width:248px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(250,250,247,.9);box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(6,10,12,.22);color:#1f2428;font-family:Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif;backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(112%);transition:opacity 130ms ease-out,transform 130ms ease-out}.ds-weather header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14)}.ds-weather header b,.ds-weather header span{display:block}.ds-weather header b{font-size:14px}.ds-weather header span,dt,footer span{margin-top:2px;color:rgba(31,36,40,.62);font-size:10px}.ds-weather header button,.ds-weather footer button{border:0;border-radius:9px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-weather header button{width:30px;height:30px;color:rgba(31,36,40,.62);font-size:18px}.ds-temp{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px;padding:12px}.ds-temp strong{font-size:25px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-temp span{color:rgba(31,36,40,.62);font-size:12px}.ds-weather dl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;margin:0 12px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14);border-radius:10px}.ds-weather dl div{padding:8px 9px}.ds-weather dl div+div{border-left:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14)}.ds-weather dt{margin:0}.ds-weather dd{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-weather footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:42px;padding:0 12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(31,36,40,.14)}.ds-weather footer button{height:32px;color:#2f80a8;font:600 11px Segoe UI,PingFang SC,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-weather button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f04a1d;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
TRIP 3D is a restrained, authored Chinese cartography workspace. A continuous natural-terrain map carries the route, while near-black operational chrome makes the controls legible without competing for the first glance. The route-orange line and primary action establish the only urgent visual voice.

The product feels like a dependable field instrument: compact rounded controls, short Chinese labels, ordered row content, and progressive disclosure let planning, terrain, time, and weather remain facets of one trip. Frosted material is reserved for information anchored to the map, so geographic context survives without turning the interface into glass decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Map-first operating canvas with slim edge chrome and a single filled route action.
Natural, quiet terrain and paper-like information surfaces rather than dashboard-card density.
Restrained Chinese system typography with compact metadata and tabular numerical detail.
Orange route selection, blue weather information, and direct truthful status colors.
Rounded, familiar controls; dense information remains in rows, sheets, and drawers.

rules.name: The One Route Voice Rule
rules.body: Route orange is reserved for the active route, its direct selection state, and the single primary action; it is not a general decorative accent.

rules.name: The Operational Type Rule
rules.body: Use weight, size, and short labels to establish priority; do not add a second display voice or force dense route data into oversized type.

rules.name: The Continuous Map Rule
rules.body: Chrome attaches to the map edge or collapses into the shared sheet; no open state may fragment the trip into competing dashboard columns.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Use elevation only to establish a floating map context; do not add shadows to ordinary content rows or invent a card hierarchy.

rules.name: The Contextual Frost Rule
rules.body: Blur belongs exclusively to map-anchored information and dark/light map controls, with opaque fallbacks when reduced transparency is requested.

rules.name: The Grouped Row Rule
rules.body: Reserve rounded outer corners for a meaningful group; internal rows divide with fine lines and selection rules instead of acquiring individual card silhouettes.

dos: Do keep the map and route as the default visual proof of the product.
Do use Route Ember only for movement, explicit selection, and the one primary action.
Do keep high-frequency controls compact at 40px on desktop and reachable at 44px touch targets on mobile.
Do use frosted dark or light material only for map-anchored context, with an opaque reduced-transparency fallback.
Do group itinerary, settings, and metrics into lined rows with progressive disclosure.
donts: Don't turn the workspace into a generic AI dashboard, feature-wall card grid, or decorative metric wall.
Don't use pervasive glass, glow, gradient identity, or invented smart claims.
Don't give every field, metric, or itinerary segment its own rounded card.
Don't use hover lift, bounce, broad `transition: all`, or decorative entrance sequences.
Don't silently hide unavailable, stale, or provider-limited trip information behind polished visual treatment.
